convert_proto_to_cpp: run proto2cpp.py on a .proto file to convert it to C++ style output for Doxygen
handle_proto_file: handle a .proto file by parsing it and printing C++ style output to stdout
parse_proto_syntax: parse a .proto file line by line replacing message with struct and import with include
configure_logging: configure the proto2cpp converter logging level to logNone, logErrors, or logAll
run_doxygen_filter: run proto2cpp.py as a Doxygen INPUT_FILTER to generate documentation from .proto files
